priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility for overseeing financing transactions to the Finance Committee. Everson, a designee of Toby Neugebauer, did not serve on any committee of the Board at the time of his resignation.
